name: Line boil
one_line: Hand-drawn lines redrawn on a stepped cadence so they shimmer like traditional animation
summary: Outlines and fills are redrawn with slightly different wobble every few frames, so still drawings seem alive and hand-made. It suits sketchy, informal, human-scaled pieces. The step must be steady and the wobble consistent; per-frame jitter reads as electrical noise, not craft.

routes.one_line: Redraw sketchy shapes with a seed that changes only on each step

steps.does: Draw hand-drawn shapes whose seed comes from stepped time, redrawn on each seek

limits: Evidence covers a hachure rectangle, solid ellipse and closed path; no stepped seed is tested
No SVG output evidence; this route is canvas only
Text and fine detail do not come out of it

routes.one_line: Wobble vector art with a displacement filter whose noise seed steps on a cadence

steps.does: Author the vector drawing and a displacement filter, its seed set from stepped time

limits: SVG evidence is one static raster by resvg; no filter or animation was exercised
anime-js evidence covers transforms, stroke draw and stagger, not filter attributes
Filter output differs between rasterisers; check in the capture browser

routes.one_line: Jitter hand-built stroke geometry in a seeded sketch redrawn on each step

steps.does: Offset stroke points with seeded noise keyed to stepped time and redraw

limits: p5.js evidence is a static noLoop sketch captured on Linux; stepped redraw is untested
Stroke style is yours to build; there is no ready hand-drawn look
